content.answer: Fix rule: never rebuild a Feishu Bitable single-select (or multi-select) field by sending a bare list of option names — always merge by stable option id: pass existing options through unchanged (same id + same name), give only genuinely new names fresh ids continuing from max(existing id)+1, because rebuilding by name alone makes the API assign brand-new ids and silently clears every existing row's reference to that field.
content.reuse_advice: Reusable rule for any id-referenced catalog update: treat the catalog as id-addressed, not name-addressed. On update, diff by stable id — keep existing entries' ids and payloads intact, only append truly new entries with ids continuing after the current max id, and never regenerate ids for items that already exist. If you must rename, update the name while preserving the id. Sending a name-only list forces the backend to recreate entries with new ids, which silently orphans/clears every existing reference to the old ids; verify after update that existing rows still resolve their references.
